title: Peanut Butter Blondies
changes_from_base: Crunchy peanut butter in the batter, milk chocolate chips and chopped peanuts on top.
summary: A large tray of crunchy peanut butter blondies with milk chocolate chips and chopped peanuts.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat to 180 °C (160 °C fan) with a lined 23 x 33 cm tin ready, and whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the brown sugar with the melted butter, eggs and vanilla until smooth, then whisk in the peanut butter.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Stir in the flour mixture, then the chocolate chips. Spread evenly in the tin and sprinkle the chopped peanuts over.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 22-26 min, until deep golden and a skewer in the middle shows a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin, then cut into 24 bars.

tips: Use a standard peanut butter rather than a natural one that separates.
Unsalted peanuts keep the salt in check.
Let them cool fully before cutting.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
